body:
As I want to grow my avicus series I need more people to commentate with since I am really boring when it comes down to only me commentating. We will try to maintain a PG-13 level since there are a few players that may watch this and not be allowed to hear swearing and other vulgure things.

skype: swagishighyouislow

Teamspeak: we can meet in avicus's :)!

I do not want you to feel as if I'm trying to make u refrain from cursing but just as simply keep it to a minimum if possible :), I do not personally mind it But I don't want to be responsible for someone getting grounded because their mom walked in and heard someone cursing when they were told not to listen to or even say those words.
